title: MAINTENANCE
ocr_text:
MAINTENANCE

Page
MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE ............................ MA-2
MAINTENANCE OPERATIONS ............................. MA-6
GENERAL MAINTENANCE .................................. MA-14

GENERAL NOTES:
• The maintenance schedule for the vehicle consists of separate A and B schedules which are applicable depending on how the vehicle is used. Confirm the vehicle's usage conditions, select the appropriate schedule and service the vehicle accordingly (See page MA-2 for details).
• Every service item in the periodic maintenance list be performed.
• Failure to do even one item can cause the engine to run poorly and increase exhaust emissions.
